name: Undress
description: Make one or more NPCs remove their clothing/armor.
prompt:
CRITICAL SYSTEM COMMAND - EQUIPMENT REMOVAL TRIGGER:

This tool removes clothing/armor from NPCs.

EXECUTION RULES:
- NPC INTENT: Fire this tool if you (the NPC) want to undress, or if you state in your dialogue that you are taking your clothes off.
- PLAYER EVENT: Fire this tool if the player inputs an event log stating that you or they are undressing (e.g., 'Player removes NPCs clothes').
- CONSECUTIVE OVERRIDE: You may fire this tool consecutively if the intent or event occurs again.

If you want to undress, say you will undress, or the player event log dictates undressing, begin your response with '{key}:'.
